slides.title: What's happening at Merck right now
slides.kicker: Four signals from the last twelve months · Numbered sources on page 15

items.head: FDA is going after the 60-second drug spot
items.body: About 100 cease-and-desist letters since Sep 2025. A rule to end "adequate provision" for broadcast ads is on FDA's 2026 agenda, with a proposal expected in December. [1, 2]
items.means: Broadcast spots get longer, riskier and pricier. Tightly targeted CTV becomes the safer place for reach.

items.head: Bravecto Quantum's label adds two more ticks
items.body: The only 12-month flea and tick injection, given by a vet, now covers Asian longhorned and Gulf Coast ticks. The longhorned tick is confirmed in 19 states. [5, 6]
items.means: Every sale starts with a vet visit. That's a household we can find and move before winter.

items.head: Keytruda Qlex approved in Japan, CHMP backs Keytruda + Padcev
items.body: The Keytruda family grew 4% to $8.4B in Q2. Cipla has licensed a US Keytruda biosimilar ahead of the 2028 patent expiry. [7, 8]
items.means: Every oncologist conversation about subcutaneous Keytruda counts now. HCP reach at home adds to field and endemic.

items.head: Enflonsia heads into its second RSV season
items.body: $3MM in 1H sales on heavy market inventory, with shipments expected to rise in 2H. FDA's second-season decision is due Mar 22, 2027. [9]
items.means: Pediatric practices decide in the next 90 days. A precise pediatric HCP deal fits that window.

slides.title: The opening: audiences, not airtime
slides.kicker: Why the next Merck reach dollar should buy a household, not a daypart
slides.statLabel: FDA cease-and-desist letters on pharma ads since September 2025, with most untitled letters aimed at DTC television
slides.headline: We think the next Merck reach dollar goes to audiences, not airtime.

points.head: The shift
points.body: Pharma digital passes linear TV in 2026, and CTV is the fastest-growing line in it. Budgets are moving whether the rule lands or not.

points.head: The gap
points.body: Much of pharma CTV still buys demographics or modeled health segments. Those are getting harder to defend with MLR teams and new state health-privacy laws.

points.head: Where Sabio fits
points.body: App Science® targets observed app ownership (pet care, clinician tools, care management), never a diagnosis. Activated as PMP deals on Omnicom's own seats.

slides.kicker: Built on our own data, tech and content since 2014

slides.title: From the screen to the vet
slides.kicker: One household, three moments · The TV builds the idea, the phone closes it
slides.benchmark: Benchmark: CTV video with QR code, 96% VCR. Human Health follows the same path to a Merck HCP or unbranded page.

steps.head: Tick season on the big screen
steps.body: Tick-country dog homes see Bravecto Quantum messaging on CTV. The QR code goes to a vet finder or the brand page.

steps.head: The same home, on the phone
steps.body: The households exposed on CTV are retargeted with mobile video and display, one tap from the vet finder.

steps.head: Book the once-a-year shot
steps.body: The page drives a vet booking or a question at the next appointment. We read site visits and, where Merck allows, vet visits by household.

slides.title: Two ways to read the test
slides.kicker: Action and awareness, read against the same 10% holdout
slides.source: Source: Sabio Performance attribution and App Science® brand-lift materials, 2025 – 2026. Crossix available as an alternative for pharma measurement.

paths.head: Action · CTV view-through and mobile click-through
steps: Ad plays on the TV or phone. Household IP or device ID is logged
Someone in the home visits the vet finder or brand page
The Sabio pixel records the visit, with no personal data passed
Visits matched to exposure and compared with the holdout

paths.head: Awareness · App Science® brand-lift study
steps: Exposed households are connected to the household graph
A short survey goes to exposed homes and a matched control
Awareness and intent to ask the vet, by audience
Lift read by audience and demo, feeding the next flight

Adult ticks stay active into November, so dog owners are in market right now.

slides.title: Pharma guardrails
slides.kicker: What we see, what we don't, and what we won't do
slides.source: Source: Sabio Internal FAQ and CTV FAQ, 2026. All Human Health targeting subject to Merck MLR review before launch.

cells.head: What we observe
cells.body: Which apps are installed and how recently they're used. Never what anyone reads or types inside a health app.

cells.head: No condition inference
cells.body: We don't build audiences that imply a diagnosis. HCP and care-manager signals only, unless Merck MLR approves more.

cells.head: State health-data laws
cells.body: Built to sit outside consumer health data as defined by laws like Washington's My Health My Data Act. [CONFIRM with Merck legal]

cells.head: What leaves Sabio
cells.body: No device IDs. Reporting is aggregated by age, demo and geo. CCPA compliant, and every opt-out is honored.

cells.head: Merck 1P
cells.body: HCP target lists or NPI files can be layered in through a clean room, on Merck's terms.

cells.head: Brand safety
cells.body: DoubleVerify on all supply, TAG registered, US only. Block and allow lists accepted.
